title: Rationale
html:
Rationale

Microsoft's Azure growth falls below 48% in its January 27 report

Azure beat its own guidance by three to four points last quarter (48% against 44%-45%), and analysts look for 49%-50%. A print under 48% needs that pattern to break. What could break it: capacity ('capacity constraints prevented Azure from growing even faster'), this month's outages, and capital spending that already came in below expectations. I put it a little above one in five.
